page.layout: One column of running text with Hebrew, Chaldee and Latin entries; Hebrew and Aramaic words are set in their own type, interleaved with the Latin. No marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf (ignored).

main_text.p: מְקֻלּוּף Chald. Decorticatum, Plur. מְקֻלּוּפִין, Num. 6.4. in Jonathane.
קְלִיפִין Chal. Squamæ, Levit. 11.8.9. Syr. ܩܠܦܐ Squama, Act. 9.18.

קוּלְפָּא, קוּלְפִּי Ch. Clava, fustis, baculus ligneus, in cujus summitate est globus crassus, inquit Scholiastes Hebræus, Levit. 20.15.16. in Jonat. Germ. Kolb, Lat. Clava; convenit etiam cum כּוּלְבָּא Ch. & Syr. ܟܝܠܦܐ Hebr. unde pluralis כֵּילַפּוֹת exstat.
קלק Ch. Idem quod טלק Conjecit, projecit, Exod. 15.25. in Targ. Hierosol.
קוּלְרִין Ch. Claustra, collaria, clausuræ ferreæ, quæ collo imponuntur, Ezech. 19.9. emph. קוּלְרָיָא Num. 21.31. in T. H.
קלש Ithpeћal אִתְקְלִישׁ Chald. Attenuari, idem quod אִתְחַלִּישׁ, Genes. 21.15. in Jon.
קְלִישׁ Ch. Tenuis, attenuatus, Num. 7.13.19. in Jon.
קַלְשׁוּנִין Ch. Furcæ, bidentes, tridentes, Eccles. 12.11.
קמח קְמְחָא Ch. ܩܡܚܐ Syr. Farina.
קמט Ch. Tenere, capere, apprehendere, Prov. 5.22. Pahel קַמֵּט Idem. Deinde Hebr. est Corrugare, Rugas contrahere. Hinc ܩܡܛܐ Syr. Ruga, Eph. 5.27.
קוּמְטְרֵיָא, קוּמְטְרִין Ch. Vestiaria, Capsæ in quibus asservantur vestes, Ezech. 27.24. & 2. Reg. 10.22.
קוּמִיטִין Ch. Comitatus, ut Munsterus & Guido explicant, Num. 12.7. in T. Hier. Est qui exponit הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת Abscondita, occulta, secreta.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are reproduced as best legible; vowel points and some Syriac forms are uncertain and may contain errors. The final Hebrew word at lower right is a catchword-like mark and has been placed as a closing paragraph.
